Checkmarx AST GitHub Actions Compromise

Target: checkmarx-ast
Repository: https://github.com/Checkmarx/ast-github-action
Date: 2026-03-21 to 2026-04-25 (35 days)
Attribution: Advanced Persistent Threat
Component: Application
Language: Go
Cause: Compromised Account/Credentials
Motive: Credential Theft
Transitive: true
Impact Type: Data Leak/Extortion
User Impact: 0
Domain: github.com (repository)
Artifact Type: action
Insertion Phase: ci/cd

Synopsis

Attackers (TeamPCP) used a compromised service account to push malicious code into Checkmarx's GitHub repositories, including kics-github-action and ast-github-action. They hijacked 35 release tags (e.g., v1, v2) via spoofed commits. The payload stole environment variables, SSH keys, AWS Metadata, and Kubernetes tokens, exfiltrating data to checkmarx.zone. They also published malicious OpenVSX extensions (cx-dev-assist, ast-results).
